data.title: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. Enters into Agreement to Acquire JoyPak Supply LLC
data.description: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. based in Irvine, California, disclosed on September 15, 2026, that they have signed a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to buy out JoyPak Supply LLC completely. The company, listed on Nasdaq CM as CTNT, is set to acquire all membership interests of JoyPak, a Nevada-based limited liability company, specializing in the retail of consumer goods, beauty products, personal care items, and various everyday-use products. The deal involves purchasing these interests from two limited liability companies based in Delaware and Texas, acting as the Sellers. This acquisition marks a significant move for Cheetah in expanding its presence in the consumer goods market.

data.title: 3 E Network Highlights Strategic Value of Finnish Market Amid Nordic AI Infrastructure Investment Boom
data.description: The Finnish market is being recognized for its strategic importance within the Nordic region amid a surge in investments in AI infrastructure. The 3E Network has emphasized the significance of Finland, with experts predicting a substantial increase in funding for AI projects in the region. This development underscores Finland's position as a key player in the growing AI sector within the broader Nordic context. The investment boom is expected to attract significant capital, with projections indicating a noteworthy rise in financial allocations for AI initiatives across Finland.

data.title: DIU Selects Defense Unicorns to Accelerate Air Mobility Command OMEN Efforts
data.description: Defense Unicorns, a veteran-owned defense technology company based in San Antonio, launched the UDS Fleet, aimed at aiding commanders and aircrews in deploying, updating, monitoring, and maintaining mission software in challenging environments. The innovative system will provide support across contested, disconnected, and operationally constrained areas. The launch, as of September 15, 2026, marks a significant milestone for the company and its mission to enhance military operations with cutting-edge technology.

data.title: Trusted by Workers Since 1993, SCRUBS® Brings The Original Waterless Cleaning Towel™ to Today's Industrial Buyers
data.description: In a recent update, the entire range of products under the SCRUBS® brand has undergone a comprehensive relabeling process. This initiative aims to streamline the process of selecting the appropriate industrial cleaning product for distributors, facility managers, and workers. The refresh in labeling ensures that the trusted performance, which has been synonymous with SCRUBS® for over three decades, is maintained. The development was announced in OLATHE, Kan., on Sept. 15, 2026. This enhanced labeling is set to provide clear guidance on product selection and maintain the high standards expected from SCRUBS® products.

data.title: Media Advisory: Emergent to Host Ribbon Cutting Ceremony at Canton Manufacturing Facility
data.description: A ribbon cutting ceremony will be held by Emergent BioSolutions Inc. (NYSE: EBS) on September 16, 2026, at 10 a.m. ET in Canton, Massachusetts. This event marks the restart and expansion of the manufacturing facility, showcasing the company's commitment to advancing biopharmaceutical manufacturing in the Commonwealth.

data.title: Veteran Talent Source, Powered by Findem, Named a 2026 Top HR Product of the Year by HR Executive
data.description: Expert-verified data helps employers recognize and hire qualified veterans, transitioning service members, and military spouses by equating military expertise with civilian abilities. This revolutionary approach provides employers with reliable information to engage and consider candidates effectively. The company Findem, based in Redwood City, California, unveiled this innovative AI platform on September 15, 2026. By leveraging this technology, employers can tap into a pool of capable individuals who bring valuable experience from the military, potentially transforming their workforce.

data.title: Christian Poetry Collection Confronts Addiction, Shame and the Work of Healing with God
data.description: Author John Giertz shares his journey battling pornography and sexual addiction to delve into the concepts of repentance, grace, and building faith in Christ during recovery. This revelation comes from Bakersfield, California, on September 15, 2026. Giertz's personal story sheds light on the challenges many face, with insights that resonate with a large audience. His words are derived from confronting his struggles, offering hope and guidance to those seeking solace amidst similar battles. Through his narrative, Giertz underscores the importance of faith and determination in overcoming personal dilemmas, with his perspective capturing attention and garnering support.

data.title: Globalli Announces Certified Workday Marketplace App, Transforming Global Payroll Operations for Workday Customers

This certification signifies the capability of seamless integration between Globalli and Workday HCM.

data.title: Morocco Strategic Minerals Reports New Gold Mineralization North of Aït Zekri and Announces Stock Option Grants
data.description: A recent update from Morocco Strategic Minerals reveals the discovery of fresh gold mineralization at Tamdghoust, along with promising copper-silver findings. Additionally, progress has been made in the drilling activities at Aït Zekri. This development signifies a significant step forward in the company's exploration efforts. The details of the gold mineralization at Tamdghoust, coupled with the copper-silver results, indicate the potential for valuable resources at the site. Furthermore, the advancement in drilling plans at Aït Zekri underlines the commitment of Morocco Strategic Minerals to unlocking the mineral wealth in the region. The findings suggest a positive outlook for the company's future prospects in the mining sector.
